components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:27px;padding:12px;background:var(--ink,#0c0d0f);color:#c4c5c8;font:13px var(--body,Golos,sans-serif)}.ds-nav a{position:relative;padding:16px 0;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:after{content:"";height:1px;background:var(--red,#d71425);position:absolute;bottom:10px;left:0;width:100%;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .4s var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))}.ds-nav a:hover{color:white}.ds-nav a:hover:after{transform:scaleX(1)}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--red,#d71425);outline-offset:6px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav,.ds-nav *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

narrative.overview:
The Light Tunnel translates the supplied black, red and silver shield into a dark automotive studio: broad engineered lettering, a single illuminated automobile, precise rules and squared controls. Large silver service and branch surfaces interrupt the black ground; saturated red fields give the care form and final invitation their own visual weight.

The built system is flat and deliberate. Light lives inside imagery and its masking layers, while interface states use a red stroke, an underline, a small directional movement or an inverted surface. Russian body copy stays sober and readable beside the wide display face. Generated automotive illustrations remain visibly identified until authentic client photography is supplied.
keyCharacteristics: Black studio ground with silver reading surfaces and branded red fields.
Wide Unbounded headings paired with compact Golos text.
Squared controls, fine rules and flat tonal layers.
Image-bound light, restrained directional motion and a reduced-motion alternative.

rules.name: The Branded Surface Rule
rules.body: Use the existing black, silver and red surface relationships: dark studio framing, silver information sections, and red contact or selection fields.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Unbounded for the brand and major headings; use Golos for prose, controls and operational detail.

rules.name: The Light Within Rule
rules.body: Keep the light reveal and photographic gradients inside image composition; interface surfaces use tonal separation and fine rules rather than box shadows.

dos: Do preserve the supplied shield, black/red/silver identity and two-font relationship.
Do retain square controls, visible keyboard focus and explicit selected states.
Do preserve the responsive tab orientation, scrollable mobile choices and reduced-motion behavior.
Do label generated illustrations visibly and preserve their provenance when replacing or reusing imagery.
donts: Don't present generated illustrations as completed client work.
Don't substitute rounded pill controls or floating shadow cards for the built squared, flat components.
Don't make pointer-following light or animation necessary to read content or complete a contact request.
